changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. Nottingham voters approved the Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers Ordinance 1,335-143 at the September 8, 2026 special town election. The ordinance is now in legal effect townwide for 12 months (through approximately September 8, 2027), prohibiting acceptance, processing, or approval of permits or approvals for the establishment, construction, expansion, or operation of data centers in every zoning district. No repeal or amendment was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.

changes.before: Active as of 2026-09-23. Ordinance 2172-2026 was introduced June 16, 2026 and finally passed at the Council's July 14, 2026 meeting (notice published July 15, 2026), establishing a six-month moratorium on the approval, development, construction, expansion, and operation of data centers while the Planning Board and Environmental Commission study the issue. The moratorium is set to run through approximately January 10, 2027. No extension, repeal, or permanent ordinance was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.

The prior January 10, 2027 endpoint was an unsupported 180-day calculation and is cleared.
